model.name: group_huber20_inverse_flow
model.formula: delta_CO2_180_ppm = silicone_location if material == Silicone else non_silicone_location * (20 / flow_cm_s)^1

target.definition: median of 1-s CO2 medians at [150,180) s minus median at [-30,0) s; ppm; electrical ignition reference; signed sensor response

validation.selection_limitation: Repeated candidate selection on LOOCV makes best RMSE optimistic; no independent test set or causal atmosphere effect is claimed

source.citation: Urban DL, Ruff G. "Spacecraft Fire Experiment-II(SAFFIRE-II)", NASA PSI Data Repository, Version 5
source.attribution: NASA supplied measurements and published outcomes. Extraction, the CO2 response, modeling and interpretations were produced in this study.
